subject: Logic
title: Distribution Laws
description: A fast breakdown of Distribution Laws for builders.

hook.text: In math, a(b + c) = ab + ac. Logic has the same trick: AND distributes over OR, and vice versa.

buildup.text: P ∧ (Q ∨ R) ≡ (P ∧ Q) ∨ (P ∧ R). AND distributes over OR just like multiplication over addition.

discovery.text: P ∨ (Q ∧ R) ≡ (P ∨ Q) ∧ (P ∨ R). OR distributes over AND too—a symmetry math doesn't have.

twist.text: In algebra, addition doesn't distribute over multiplication. Logic is more symmetric than arithmetic.

climax.text: Distribution lets you expand or factor logical formulas—essential for simplification and proofs.

punchline.text: Expand or factor—logic goes both ways.
